turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so you have twenty minutes. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. Now tell me what you have that a person can check.

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.

I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. People draft in one place and paste into another, Hale, so a paste tells you where the words landed, not who wrote them. And none of that changes 4.2: you had this before you entered the zero, and you still didn't pick up the phone.
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
You've told me where the words appeared, Hale, and I've told you why that proves nothing about who wrote them. Did you ask Owen before you entered the zero, yes or no? And what else do you have?
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the one being questioned, Hale. You still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed, though you admitted you entered the zero before calling me. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and a straight answer on whether anyone spoke to him before the mark went in. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: At her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on whether Owen was heard first, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and moved on, which earned one small sign of ground because it took her strongest procedural grievance off the table.
What cost ground: You asked what Owen was doing at midnight, a question about what she has seen at home, which she will never answer and which let her swing back to procedure instead of your evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history landed squarely on a late night in October, the night before it was due, which is exactly why she went short and hard to procedure; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she argued that a paste only shows where the words landed, answer that with something she can check against Owen's own work, such as his other writing samples under 4.3, then offer 4.4 in writing, rather than restating the times or asking about his night.
